TSVSL.Settings.Enabled.Name: Level box on the Progression view
TSVSL.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Show a box beside Level Up for typing the level you want.
TSVSL.Label: Go to level
TSVSL.Hint: Type a level and press the arrows: the character gains each level in turn, so every choice is still asked for.
TSVSL.Go: Take this character to that level
TSVSL.NoClass: Choose a class first - levels are gained in a class.
TSVSL.Done: {name}: level {from} to {to}. Anything still to choose is marked on the Progression view.
TSVSL.Down.Title: Level down?
TSVSL.Settings.HitPoints.Name: Hit points when jumping levels
TSVSL.Settings.HitPoints.Hint: Left alone, each level keeps its own Take Average / Roll Hit Die buttons on the Progression view. The other settings decide them all at once when you jump levels.
TSVSL.Settings.HitPoints.Ask: Ask level by level on the sheet (default)
TSVSL.DoneHP: {name}: level {from} to {to}, hit points for {hp} levels ({mode}). Anything still to choose is marked on the Progression view.
TSVSL.FilledHP: {name}: hit points filled in for {hp} levels.
TSVSL.HP.Label: {n} levels need hit points:
TSVSL.Settings.Editable.Name: Type hit points by hand
TSVSL.Settings.Editable.Hint: Puts a small number field on each level's hit points row, for typing a value instead of rolling - or correcting one already taken.
TSVSL.Edit.Hint: Type this level's hit die result (1-{die}). The constitution modifier is added on top.
TSVSL.Settings.Ascending.Name: List levels 1st to 20th
TSVSL.Settings.Ascending.Hint: On the Progression view, show the earliest level at the top. Off gives Black Flag's own order, highest level first.
TSVSL.HP.AverageTip: Give every level still missing hit points the class's average hit die result.
TSVSL.HP.RollTip: Roll the hit die for every level still missing hit points, one roll per level.
TSVSL.Asi.Title: {name}: raise an ability
TSVSL.Asi.Prompt: {name} raises one ability score by 1 (to a maximum of 20). Which one?
TSVSL.Asi.Skipped: {name}: no ability chosen, so no score was raised. Remove the talent and add it again to choose.
TSVSL.Asi.AllMax: {name}: every ability it can raise is already 20.
TSVSL.Settings.Guide.Name: Character creation tips
TSVSL.Settings.Guide.Hint: Tooltips on a character sheet that walk a player through making a character, step by step.
TSVSL.Guide.Abilities: Step 1: set your six ability scores.
TSVSL.Guide.lineage: Step 2: choose your lineage, your ancestry.
TSVSL.Guide.heritage: Step 3: choose your heritage, the culture you grew up in.
TSVSL.Guide.background: Step 4: choose your background, your life before adventuring. It gives skills and a talent.
TSVSL.Guide.class: Step 5: choose your class. This makes you level 1.
TSVSL.Guide.Progression: Open Progression: level up, make your choices, and decide hit points.
TSVSL.Guide.LevelUp: Gain a level. Answer its new prompts below.
TSVSL.Guide.Locked: Locked: play and answer level-up prompts. Click to unlock for editing.
TSVSL.Guide.Unlocked: Unlocked: edit or delete items. Level-up prompts are hidden until you lock it again.
TSVSL.Guide.HitDie: Roll your hit die for this level's hit points.
TSVSL.Guide.Average: Take the fixed average for this level's hit points instead of rolling.
